question: What is rightly established in the mind of mine-ness for the good ones?
premises: A mind can be characterized by mine-ness
The good ones can arrive at attachment
This state can be rightly established
inference: In the mind of mine-ness, when the attachment of the good ones has arrived, something is rightly established.
uncertainties: The third token contains two words in the source line but is given as one token here
plain_english: In the mind of mine-ness, when the attachment of the good ones has arrived, it is well.
